query: SELECT person_type, gender, COUNT(DISTINCT id, dependent_seq_no) AS count FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala WHERE is_in_population = true AND snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) AND person_type IN ('Saudi', 'Alien') GROUP BY person_type, gender ORDER BY person_type, gender LIMIT 1200
